Our Menu Get to know us

A little about us

Rooted in good things.

Green & Tasty brings together a network of restaurants in Tbilisi, Georgia. We make fresh, locally sourced ingredients the starting point for food that feels both nourishing and full of character.

Our menu takes inspiration from the rich flavours of Georgian cuisine, with a modern twist and plenty of vegetarian and vegan choices to share around the table.

Fresh by nature

Locally sourced ingredients bring the best of every season.

Good for everyone

Vegetarian and vegan choices are always part of the table.

Made to be shared

Honest food, warm hospitality, and room for one more.

Seasonal bowls • Vegan friendly
